guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。

factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance.

timeline: 2002　美國工兵團官方目錄列海岸工程手冊分冊
2007　歐洲研究團隊發布首版海岸越波手冊
2018　海岸越波手冊第二版擴展方法與解釋
timelineEn: 2002 — USACE official catalogue lists Coastal Engineering Manual parts
2007 — European research team publishes the first overtopping manual
2018 — The second overtopping manual expands methods and interpretation
codes: 海岸工程手冊EM1110-2-1100，按分冊適用範圍閱讀
海岸越波手冊EurOtop，第二版二〇一八年
香港海港工程設計手冊第四部，核對現行勘誤
codesEn: Coastal Engineering Manual EM1110-2-1100, within each part scope
Hong Kong Port Works Design Manual Part4, check applicable corrigenda
landmarks: 紐比金灣防護：功能比較
博斯海岸防護：監測比較
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：海堤越波模型試驗
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Overtopping model tests for seawalls
guides.concept: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
guides.conceptEn: Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
procedure: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。 假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 空氣可壓縮性與液滴破裂對縮尺的反應不同，須分開選擇可外推的觀察量。
單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。重力相似下它按長度比的二分之三次方縮放，先辨清是否已除試驗寬度，才能避免額外乘一次長度比例造成嚴重誤差。 假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。
集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。側漏、濺出、槽內滯留與試驗結束後延遲排水都會破壞收支；控制體積及起訖時刻應先定義，再討論平均越波量。 假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。 計量解析度在低越波情境尤其重要，小讀值可能與容器零點漂移相當。
不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。頻帶截取、漂移去除和量測位置會改變零階譜矩，需記清處理方法，才能把造波設定與入射波條件對上。 假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。 譜矩是波面變異的積分描述，頻率單位與積分間距必須在程式中一致。
越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。比較試驗時必須區分堤頂變化和靜水面變化，兩者在幾何上可能等效，但對前灘水深與破波位置的影響不同。 假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。 有效出水高的分母應使用結構前指定位置的入射波，而非任意遠端設定值。
結構反射與入射波疊加形成空間起伏，單點量測可能剛好位在節點或腹點。要把試驗與設計入射波連結，需用適當測點配置和分離方法；反射振幅比也不能直接當成反射能量比。 假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。 能量比例的平方關係還假設入射和反射有相同的傳播介質與群速。
波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。取樣前的類比濾波與感測器自身頻率響應同樣重要，事後加密插值只能增加點數，無法回復已混疊或漏掉的訊號。 假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。 感測器的固有頻率和裝置共振同樣限制有效頻帶，不能僅查擷取器規格。
跨堤水舌具有局部水深與速度，平均單寬流量無法唯一決定兩者。弗勞德數可比較慣性與重力尺度，但不含人員失衡、漂浮物及脈動衝擊；同一平均越波量仍可能對應很不同的瞬間流況。 假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。 水舌前緣可能近似乾濕交界，局部水深接近零時此比值會很敏感。
相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。重複試驗應涵蓋波列變異，而不只是重讀同一段資料；平均值的不確定度也不等於單次事件分散程度。 假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。 獨立性涉及實際波列而非檔案數量，系統校準偏差也不會隨重複次數消失。
越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。力、壓力和受力面積必須區分，壓力感測器的空間平均也會抹去小範圍峰值；不能由流量合格推論所有附屬構件合格。 假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。 峰值持續時間決定荷載衝量，結構反應也受自身頻率與阻尼控制。
procedureEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Air compressibility and droplet breakup respond differently to scaling, requiring separate decisions about which observations can be extrapolated.

Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power. Determine whether the measured quantity has already been divided by width before applying a second width conversion. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall.

A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. Side leakage, splash loss, storage and delayed drainage disrupt the balance. Define the control volume and start/end times before interpreting the measurement as mean overtopping discharge. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance. Meter resolution becomes especially important at low overtopping, where the collected increment may resemble tank zero drift.

Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description. One maximum wave cannot replace a representative height for the sequence. Frequency limits, detrending and measurement location alter the zero-order spectral moment, so processing must remain traceable when comparing generator settings with incident conditions. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1. The moment integrates surface-elevation variance, requiring consistent frequency units and integration spacing throughout the processing code.

Overtopping responds strongly to crest level relative to still water. Tide, surge and datum bias alter effective freeboard. Crest adjustment and water-level change can produce the same nominal freeboard while changing foreshore depth and breaking location differently, so the complete geometry must be retained. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40. Relative freeboard should use incident waves at the specified structure location rather than an arbitrary distant generator setting.

Reflected and incident waves create spatial interference, so a single gauge may sit near a node or antinode. Appropriate gauge geometry and separation are needed to recover incident conditions. An amplitude reflection coefficient also differs from the associated energy fraction under matched propagation conditions. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16. Squaring amplitudes for energy additionally assumes matched propagation medium and group velocity for incident and reflected components.

Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. Sampling sufficient for the main wave period may miss brief pressure peaks. Analog filtering and sensor response matter before digitization; interpolating afterward increases sample count without recovering aliased or absent information. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks. Sensor natural frequency and rig resonance also limit useful bandwidth, so acquisition specifications alone are insufficient evidence.

A crest water tongue has local depth and velocity that mean unit discharge cannot uniquely determine. The Froude number compares inertia with gravity but excludes pedestrian instability, debris and impulsive loading. Equal mean overtopping can therefore conceal very different instantaneous flow regimes at the crest. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision. The tongue front approaches a wet-dry boundary, making the ratio highly sensitive when local depth approaches zero.

The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. Repeats should sample sequence variability rather than reread identical data. Uncertainty of the mean differs from the spread of individual events or test outcomes. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented. Independence concerns the physical realization rather than file count, and shared calibration bias does not vanish through repetition.

Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. Distinguish force, pressure and loaded area; spatial averaging by a pressure sensor also smooths small peaks. Passing a discharge criterion does not qualify every secondary component. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak. Peak duration controls load impulse, while the structural response additionally depends on its natural frequencies and damping.
evidence: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。
把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。
用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。以另一種流量或重量量測交叉檢查，保留零越波與低於檢出限的區別。
保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。
從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。
evidenceEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation.

Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units.

Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits.

Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement.

Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime.
pitfalls: 若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。
狹窄收集槽可能漏掉斜向越波，餘水又可能被算到下一組試驗；這兩種偏差可互相抵銷，使平均值看似穩定，卻無法支持不同斷面的可靠比較。
模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。
過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。平滑後的波形不等於可信波形，將其當結構設計荷載前仍須確認頻率響應。
重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。
pitfallsEn: If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. Accurate geometry cannot eliminate that scale effect, and multiplying the result does not restore the missing physics.

A narrow collector can miss oblique discharge while retained water enters the next test. Opposing biases may cancel in the mean, producing apparently stable results that do not support reliable comparison between sections.

Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. The resulting discharge change may be mistaken for an improved wall geometry, and checking crest dimensions alone will not reveal the cause.

Low sampling misses short peaks, while uncontrolled electrical noise at high rates creates false ones. A smooth trace is not automatically credible, and structural load interpretation still requires demonstrated frequency response of the measurement chain.

Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Removing a high-discharge realization further distorts the tail behavior that matters for the engineering interpretation of unusually severe events.

related.title: 拋石防波堤施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「弗勞德縮尺條件」與「取樣頻帶配置」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；拋石防波堤施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Froude scaling conditions" and "Sampling bandwidth selection" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rubble-mound breakwater construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型；拋石防波堤施工則以連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains; Rubble-mound breakwater construction centres on understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「弗勞德縮尺條件」與「水下有效重量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到拋石防波堤施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「流速造成阻力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Froude scaling conditions” and “Submerged effective weight”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rubble-mound breakwater construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Current-induced drag", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海堤越波模型試驗
history.text: 本課的知識脈絡採用可核對的工程文獻，而不替工法編造單一發明年份。美國工兵團官方目錄列出二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊分冊；越波研究團隊於二〇〇七年發布首版手冊，二〇一八年第二版擴展結構型式、試驗與結果解釋。香港海港手冊持續列出勘誤，提醒設計引用必須指定版本。紐比金灣與博斯是海岸防護和監測的比較案例，不表示兩地採用了本課每項構件或假設尺寸。歷史資料用於理解方法演進，合成數據則另作學徒推理練習。
history.textEn: The knowledge history follows verifiable publications rather than inventing a single date when the technique was created. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual parts in2002. The overtopping authors issued the first manual in2007 and expanded structural types, testing and interpretation in the2018 edition. Hong Kong continues to list corrigenda, demonstrating why an applied design must identify its reference version. Newbiggin Bay and Borth are comparisons of coastal protection and monitoring, not claims that both used every component or assumed dimension in this course. Publication history explains methodological development; synthetic values separately support the apprentice exercises.
